headline: Dominican Construction Association Urges Action on Informal Labor
summary: The Dominican Confederation of Micro, Small and Medium Construction Companies (Copymecon) stated that urgent measures are required to address illegal labor in the construction industry.
why: Construction is a major driver of fixed capital formation and employment in the Dominican Republic; labor formalization affects wage costs and infrastructure development.

impacts.name: Dominican Construction Sector
impacts.why: Potential labor regulation enforcement could impact operational costs for construction firms.
